title: Estimator-Aware VLM Counterfactual Benchmark Statistical Analysis (Audit V2)

protocol_rules.r1_frame_level_autocorrelation: Per-pose residual time series in SLAM are autocorrelated and non-i.i.d. Frame-level paired t-test and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests are reported purely as exploratory/descriptive diagnostic curves. They are strictly NOT admissible as publication-level hypothesis significance decisions.
protocol_rules.r2_sequence_level_degrees_of_freedom: Statistically rigorous inferential hypothesis testing requires N >= 2 independent sequences/runs. Single-sequence evidence is flagged explicitly as INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_SEQUENCES_FOR_INFERENCE.
protocol_rules.r3_underflow_protection: Numerical underflow p-values are never written as exact 0.0 (clamped to >= 1e-16).
